verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents Smart Placement, which 'moves your Worker closer to your data for optimized end-to-end latency' and is pitched for APIs connecting to data stores. That directly matches the story's core of placing compute near backend data. The evidence is only two short marketing-level lines, so how placement decides and adapts, and whether it is truly automatic, are implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how placement is chosen and configured, evidence that it happens automatically without manual tuning, measured latency results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
